name: StellarDrive Essentials
author: Ghost
description: StellarDrive Essentials adds shipbuilding and automation parts: a distance sensor, an altimeter, a long-range LIDAR, a Signal Timer, a Signal Delay, a signal transmitter that links circuits between ships, signal-controlled doors with half-block placement, and a speed HUD for the pilot seats. The parts unlock through research and the mod registers them on its own, without SDModKit.
